title: Data Plane Principal
description: The selected Cloud Run IAM credential MUST use compact JWT serialization with exactly three non-empty, unpadded canonical base64url components. Every component MUST decode and re-encode to the exact original value before claim access; malformed, empty, padded, or alternate encodings MUST fail closed as unauthenticated before principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access. The decoded Cloud Run IAM JWT protected header MUST be a non-null JSON object using alg exactly RS256, typ exactly JWT, and a non-empty string kid without surrounding whitespace, and MUST NOT contain crit because no critical-header extensions are supported. Every top-level protected-header member name MUST occur exactly once; duplicate member names MUST fail closed instead of being resolved by parser overwrite order. Null, array, primitive, parser-invalid, duplicate-member, missing, malformed, non-string, whitespace-padded, alternate algorithm or token-type, and critical-extension headers MUST fail closed as unauthenticated before claim access, principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access. The decoded Cloud Run IAM JWT payload MUST be a non-null JSON object and MUST NOT be an array or primitive. Every top-level payload member name MUST occur exactly once; duplicate claim names MUST fail closed instead of being resolved by parser overwrite order. Null, array, primitive, and duplicate-member payloads MUST fail closed as unauthenticated before claim access, principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access; raw parser exceptions MUST NOT escape as service errors. Tenant-bound and identity-provider routes MUST accept exactly one Cloud Run IAM bearer credential from the selected transport-identity header. Duplicate, empty, or whitespace-padded transport credentials MUST fail closed before token decoding, principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access; X-Serverless-Authorization MAY remain separate from Authorization when the latter carries an end-user JWT. Providers MUST determine credential multiplicity from the raw wire-level header occurrences; normalized header maps that collapse duplicates are insufficient. The configured service audience MUST be a non-empty string without surrounding whitespace, and the exact validated value MUST be used for both token-audience matching and the emitted principal or caller audience. Malformed, empty, whitespace-only, whitespace-padded, or non-string audience configuration MUST fail closed at startup and request time before token decoding, principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access. The decoded Cloud Run IAM aud claim MUST be the configured non-empty audience string or a non-empty array of unique non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace containing the configured audience exactly once. Malformed, empty, whitespace-only, whitespace-padded, non-string, or duplicate audience entries MUST fail closed before principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access. The decoded Cloud Run IAM email claim MUST be a valid non-empty string email without surrounding whitespace and the subject claim MUST be a non-empty string without surrounding whitespace. Missing, malformed, empty, whitespace-only, whitespace-padded, or non-string principal claims MUST fail closed before normalization, principal binding, allowlist evaluation, or persistence access; email MAY be normalized to lowercase only after validation. Configured IAM principal bindings MUST map each case-insensitively unique principal email to exactly one non-empty string organization_id. Providers MUST reject duplicate raw JSON member names in principal-binding configuration before parsing; parser overwrite order MUST NOT select an organization binding. Identity-provider caller allowlists MUST contain non-empty, case-insensitively unique principal emails without surrounding whitespace. Duplicate canonical principals, malformed or whitespace-padded principal entries, and non-string or empty organization identifiers MUST fail closed at startup and request time instead of being overwritten or coerced.
